items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 26 at 1:25AM EST until November 26 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...West winds 15 to 20 knots with gusts up to 30 knots and
seas 5 to 7 feet.

* WHERE...Flagler Beach to Volusia-Brevard County Line 0-20 nm,
Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 0-20 nm and
Sebastian Inlet to Jupiter Inlet 0-20 nm.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM EST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
